title: Asking the Dealer to Clarify the Minimum Raise
summaryJa: ポーカープレイヤーが現在のベットラウンドで最小レイズ額について不確実になり、ディーラーに正確な金額を確認する状況です。トーナメントプレイ中にルールや数字を理解することは、正確な判断と流れをスムーズにするために重要です。
segments: You: What's the minimum raise from here? I want to make sure I get it right.
Dealer: The bet in front is 10,000. So your minimum raise is 20,000 total.
You: Okay, so I need to put in 20,000 more chips?
Dealer: That's correct. You already have 10,000 in the pot, so 20,000 more makes your raise to 20,000.
You: Got it, thanks. I'm raising to 20,000.
Dealer: 20,000 is in. Action is on your opponent.
